$comment: The payload file list, machine-readable. This is the single store of WHICH
files /wong-sync may copy into a target repo; payload-manifest.md beside it
holds the reasoning, the gating rules, and the exclusions — everything a flat
list cannot carry. Adding a payload file means adding it here once: the
installing agent reads this, and so does scripts/check-payload-links.mjs.
Categories gate what a given target receives. 'core' always ships. 'ui' ships
only to a repo with a frontend. 'pack' ships only where the manifest has
components.stackPack: true. 'scaffold' ships only where BOTH stackPack and
components.appScaffold are true — the pair is the gate, since the scaffold's
build and deploy path is the pack.
skillDirs are directory names under .claude/skills/, copied whole (references/
and scripts/ included). dirs are copied whole from the repo root. Anything in
'exclude' is removed after its directory is walked.

blocks.note: The block is the unit, not the file. No markers means insert the block; markers present means adapt, never rewrite in place.

$comment: Not payload — files /wong-setup writes itself, listed so the link check can
resolve links into them. An entry here is a CLAIM ABOUT wong-setup's
BEHAVIOUR: it belongs only where a step in that skill demonstrably writes
the path. Exempting a file nothing creates is what let this check report a
clean run against an install with eight dead links.
